test_case_name: Accept All Cookies on Prestiti Page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted

test_case_name: Access Cookie Policy Options from Prestiti Page

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' link to view cookie policy options
And then check that the Privacy - Cookie policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Skip to Main Content on Prestiti Page

intents.intent: Click 'Passa al Contenuto' button to skip to the main content
And then check that the focus is moved to the main content section

test_case_name: Skip to Main Menu on Prestiti Page

intents.intent: Click 'Passa al Menù' button to skip to the main menu
And then check that the focus is moved to the main menu section

test_case_name: Skip to Footer on Prestiti Page

intents.intent: Click 'Passa al Piè di pagina' button to skip to the footer
And then check that the focus is moved to the footer section

test_case_name: Open Main Menu on Prestiti Page

intents.intent: Click 'Menu' button to open the main menu
And then check that the main menu is displayed

test_case_name: Open Search Functionality on Prestiti Page

intents.intent: Click 'Search' button to open the search functionality
And then check that the search input field is displayed

test_case_name: Search for a Product on Prestiti Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Type $name into 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click 'Cerca (desktop)' button to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Reset Search on Prestiti Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'Reset ricerca (desktop)' button to clear the search input
And then check that the search input field is cleared

test_case_name: Search for a Product on Prestiti Page (Mobile)

intents.intent: Type $name into 'Cerca' input field
Click 'Cerca (mobile)' button to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Login as Guest on Prestiti Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Type $email into 'E-mail' input field
Type $password into 'Password' input field
Click 'ENTRA' button to log in as guest
And then check that the guest user is logged in and redirected appropriately

test_case_name: Enable Remember Me Option on Guest Login (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox to enable remember me option
And then check that the remember me option is enabled

test_case_name: Recover Password from Guest Login (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'Recupera Password' link to initiate password recovery
And then check that the password recovery process is started

test_case_name: Register as New User from Guest Login (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'Registrati' link to start the registration process
And then check that the registration page or form is displayed

test_case_name: Login as Guest on Prestiti Page (Mobile)

intents.intent: Type $email into 'E-mail' input field
Type $password into 'Password' input field
Click 'ENTRA' button to log in as guest
And then check that the guest user is logged in and redirected appropriately

test_case_name: Register as New User from Guest Login (Mobile)

intents.intent: Click 'REGISTRATI' button to start the registration process
And then check that the registration page or form is displayed

test_case_name: Recover Password from Guest Login (Mobile)

intents.intent: Click 'Recupera password' link to initiate password recovery
And then check that the password recovery process is started

test_case_name: Apply Product Filters on Prestiti Page (Mobile)

intents.intent: Click 'RICHIEDI ONLINE' checkbox to select the online request filter
Click 'UNDER 35' checkbox to select the under 35 filter
Click 'SOLUZIONE DOMANI' checkbox to select the Soluzione Domani filter
Click 'APPLICA FILTRI' button to apply the selected filters
And then check that the product list is filtered according to the selected criteria
